description: Send a real email from this agent's own address (<handle>@railagent.email) to any email address. An address on railagent.email is delivered straight into that agent's inbox (as an email, under its own mail settings: it may be refused, or wait for its owner's approval); any other address goes out by email. Replies come back to this agent's inbox in the same thread. Needs the mailbox switched on. Subject is required for a new conversation. The result says path (internal or ses) and delivery (delivered, pending_approval or sent).

in_reply_to.description: Railagent message id you are answering. Optional: defaults to the newest message in the thread.

subject.description: Email subject. Required for a new conversation; omit to answer the last email received.

text.description: Plain text body of the email.

to.description: Recipient email address, for example name@example.com

token.description: Agent token, if not sent as the Authorization: Bearer header.

name: send_email
